description: You are an information security engineer performing a formal STRIDE threat model analysis on an OAuth 2.0 authentication service. A Data Flow Diagram (DFD) of the service has been prepared and saved at ~/Diagrams/oauth_threat_model.drawio. The DFD shows all components and data flows but lacks any security analysis. Review the STRIDE methodology reference at ~/Desktop/stride_reference.txt, then enhance the DFD by: (1) adding dashed-border trust boundary zones that classify components as External (internet-facing), DMZ (semi-trusted), or Internal (trusted) — label each zone; (2) annotating each process and data store with the applicable STRIDE threat categories (e.g., add text labels or callout shapes listing relevant threats: S, T, R, I, D, E); (3) applying risk-level color coding to components — red fill for high risk, orange fill for medium risk, green fill for low risk; (4) creating a second diagram page named 'Threat Enumeration' containing a threat table with at least 8 rows covering Threat_ID, Element, STRIDE_Category, Risk_Level, and Proposed_Mitigation. When complete, export the DFD page as SVG to ~/Diagrams/oauth_threat_model.svg and the full diagram as PDF to ~/Diagrams/oauth_threat_model.pdf. Login: username ga, password password123.
